source_text: Globally, regions with low circumcision prevalence like Europe exhibit low HIV prevalence (0.2–0.3% among adults), contrasting with sub-Saharan Africa's higher burdens, but multivariate ecological analyses attribute part of the African disparity to circumcision status independent of socioeconomic and behavioral factors. [55]
